xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: South Eastern Coal Fields Ltd (Union of India & Ors.)
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Disputed penalty recovered by South Eastern Coal Fields Ltd. on account of short lifting of coal in terms of Fuel Supply Agreement in FY 2011-12 for short lifting of Coal quantity as per Linkage. The matter is pending under Writ Petition filed by the Company before the Hon'ble High Court of Chattisgarh, Bilaspur. South Eastern Coalfield Ltd. has imposed and recovered a penalty by encashment the bank guarantee of Rs.215.28 Lakhs in 2011-12 on account of short lifting of coal quantity in terms of Fuel Supply Agreement (FSA) dated 02.05.2008. The Company has taken up the matter with Coal India Limited/ South Eastern Coalfield Ltd. for refund of the said amount for settlement of dispute under clause 15.3 of the FSA. No provision has been made for penalty recovered since the matter is pending under writ petition filled by the Company before the Hon'ble High Court of Chattisgarh, Bilaspur. Last date of hearing was on 20.01.25.The Hon'ble High Court dated 05-04-2025 disposed of the petition and directed to both the parties to appear before General Manager (Marketing & Sales), SECL, Bilaspur (C.G.) on the 21st April, 2025 to decide mutually preferable within 60 days and disposed the case with right to petitioner to revive its prayer, if cause of action still subsists. In accordance with the order of High Court, meeting of both parties held on 19.06.2025, after that company received letter in which SECL mentioned their views and having heard the issues and with the view of SECL as mentioned therein against the respective matters, the representation of the petitioner is hereby disposed off. Now the Company has filed new Writ Petition against the order/decision of SECL before Hon’ble High Court, Chhattisgarh vide WPC/24721 of 2025
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Now the Company has filed new Writ Petition against the order/decision of SECL before Hon’ble High Court, Chhattisgarh vide WPC/24721 of 2025 dated 8-9-2025. . The Writ Petition filed by the Company against the order/decision of SECL before Hon’ble High Court, Chhattisgarh vide WPC/24721 of 2025 has been dismissed by the court on 27-10-2025. The Company is in process of filing Appeal against the said Order of Hon'ble High Court.
